stories.title: From Enterprise to Earthshot: UK’s Ecosystem Moves From Ambition to Application With NVIDIA
stories.description: Across industries, the U.K. is putting the full stack to work — and the scale of deployment is growing fast, from enterprises transforming their businesses to startups solving some of the planet’s hardest problems. NVIDIA is putting that principle into practice, including through a five-year, $250 million compute commitment to strengthen the U.K.’s agentic safety […]
